text.en: He has not said it, and he will say it. When Allah knows that a thing will come to be, He gives news of it as a report of what has already happened.

narrations.speaker: Imam al-Baqir
narrations.arabic: إن اسم الله الأكبر ثلاثة و سبعون حرفا، فاحتجب الرب تبارك و تعالى منها بحرف، فمن ثم لا يعلم أحد ما في نفسه عز و جل، أعطى آدم اثنين و سبعين حرفا، فتوارثها الأنبياء حتى صارت إلى عيسى
narrations.chain: al-Ayyashi, from Jabir al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far

text.en: The Greatest Name of Allah is seventy-three letters. The Lord veiled Himself with one letter, so that none knows what is in His self. He gave Adam seventy-two letters, which the prophets inherited until they reached Jesus.

narrations.speaker: the Prophet Muhammad
narrations.arabic: صلى رسول الله (صلى الله عليه و آله) ليلة فقرأ بآية حتى أصبح يركع بها و يسجد بها { إِن تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ } … إني سألت ربي الشفاعة لامتي فأعطانيها، و هي نائلة إن شاء الله من لا يشرك بالله شيئا
narrations.chain: al-Durr al-Manthur, from Abu Dharr

text.en: The Messenger of Allah prayed one night, reciting a single verse until dawn, bowing and prostrating with it: 'If You punish them, they are indeed Your creatures.' He then said, 'I asked my Lord for intercession for my community and He granted it; it will reach whoever does not associate anything with Allah.'

narrations.speaker: Imam al-Baqir
narrations.arabic: إذا كان يوم القيامة وحشر الناس للحساب فيمرون بأهوال يوم القيامة … ثم يدعى بإمام أمام وباهل عالمه فيحتجون بحجتهم فيقبل الله عذرهم ويجيز حجتهم قال: ثم يقول الله هذا يوم ينفع الصادقين صدقهم
narrations.chain: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man, from Durays, from Abu Ja'far

text.en: When the Day of Resurrection comes and people are gathered for the reckoning, they pass through its terrors… Then imam after imam is summoned with the people of his age; they present their proof, Allah accepts their plea and admits their proof, and then Allah says, 'This day truthfulness shall benefit the truthful.'

perspectives.en: On 'this day truthfulness shall benefit the truthful,' the two traditions gloss 'the truthful' differently. Ibn Kathir, citing Ibn Abbas, reads it as the day the monotheists profit from their monotheism. [21] Qurtubi restricts it to their truthfulness in this world, since truthfulness no longer profits in the Hereafter. [25] A narration from al-Baqir in Qummi instead places the words at the close of a long reckoning in which the Pen, the Tablet, the prophets, and then Ali and the Imams after the Prophet are summoned to testify, and only then does Allah declare it the day the truthful profit. [9]

sources.author: Allamah Muhammad Husayn Tabatabai

excerpt.text: وقد عبرت الآية عن مريم بالامومة فقيل { اتخذوني وأُمي إلهين } دون أن يُقال { اتخذوني ومريم إلهين } للدلالة على عمدة حجتهم في الألوهية وهو ولادته منها بغير أب

sources.gloss: The verse refers to Mary by motherhood, saying 'take me and my mother as two gods' rather than 'take me and Mary as two gods,' to point to the mainstay of their argument for divinity: his birth from her without a father.

sources.author: Shaykh al-Tabrisi

excerpt.text: والصحيح الأول لأن الله عقَّب هذه الآية بقولـه { هذا يوم ينفع الصادقين صدقهم } وأراد به يوم القيامة

sources.gloss: The correct view is the first: Allah followed this verse with 'This day truthfulness shall benefit the truthful,' meaning the Day of Resurrection.

sources.author: Shaykh al-Tabrisi

excerpt.text: { هذا يوم ينفع الصادقين صدقهم } يعني ما صدقوا فيه في دار التكليف لأَن يوم القيامة لا تكليف فيه على أحد

sources.gloss: 'This day truthfulness shall benefit the truthful' means what they were truthful in during the abode of accountability, for on the Day of Resurrection there is no accountability upon anyone.

sources.author: Shaykh al-Tusi

excerpt.text: تقريع في صورة الاستفهام والمراد بذلك تقريع وتهديد من ادعى ذلك

sources.gloss: A rebuke in the form of a question, meant as rebuke and warning to whoever made that claim.

sources.author: Shaykh al-Tusi

excerpt.text: وعندي أن الذي ذكره لا يدل على أنه أماته، لان التوفي هو القبض اليه ولا يستفاد منه الموت الا بشاهد الحال

sources.gloss: In my view what he cited does not prove that He caused him to die, because tawaffi means taking him up, and death is not inferred from it except by a contextual indicator.

sources.author: Shaykh al-Tusi

excerpt.text: وانه أراد بذلك تفويض الامر الى مالكه وتسليمه الى مدبره والتبري من أن يكون له شيء من أمر قومه

sources.gloss: He intended by it to hand the matter over to its Owner, submit it to its Disposer, and disown having any part in his people's affair.

sources.author: Shaykh al-Tusi

excerpt.text: ثم بين ان الصادقين ينفعهم صدقهم وهو ما صدقوا فيه في دار التكليف، لان يوم القيامة لا تكليف فيه على أحد

sources.gloss: Then He made clear that the truthful profit from their truthfulness, which is what they were truthful in during the abode of accountability, for on the Day of Resurrection there is no accountability upon anyone.

sources.author: Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Qummi

excerpt.text: فلفظ الآية ماضٍ ومعناه مستقبل ولم يقله بعد وسيقوله

sources.gloss: The wording of the verse is past but its meaning is future; he has not said it yet, and he will say it.

sources.author: Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Qummi

excerpt.text: ثم يدعى بإمام أمام وباهل عالمه فيحتجون بحجتهم فيقبل الله عذرهم ويجيز حجتهم قال: ثم يقول الله هذا يوم ينفع الصادقين صدقهم

sources.gloss: Then imam after imam is summoned with the people of his age; they present their proof, Allah accepts their plea and admits their proof, and then Allah says, 'This day truthfulness shall benefit the truthful.'

sources.author: Sayyid Hashim al-Bahrani

excerpt.text: لم يقله، و سيقوله، إن الله إذا علم أن شيئا كائن أخبر عنه خبر ما قد كان

sources.gloss: He has not said it, and He will say it; when Allah knows a thing will be, He reports it as a report of what has already happened.

sources.author: Sayyid Hashim al-Bahrani

excerpt.text: إني سألت ربي الشفاعة لامتي فأعطانيها، و هي نائلة إن شاء الله من لا يشرك بالله شيئا

sources.gloss: I asked my Lord for intercession for my community and He granted it to me; it will reach, God willing, whoever does not associate anything with Allah.

sources.author: Ibn Kathir

excerpt.text: قال الضحاك عن ابن عباس يقول يوم ينفع الموحدين توحيدهم

sources.gloss: al-Dahhak related from Ibn Abbas: it means the day the monotheists profit from their monotheism.

sources.author: al-Qurtubi

excerpt.text: أي صدقهم في الدنيا فأما في الآخرة فلا ينفع فيها الصدق

sources.gloss: That is, their truthfulness in this world; as for the Hereafter, truthfulness does not benefit in it.
